facts.four-wands-garland: A garland woven of flowers and fruit hangs across four wands set up in front.
facts.ribbons: Red ribbons are tied to the tips of the two outer wands.
facts.two-women: Two women hold bouquets of flowers up over their heads.
facts.castle: Behind them is a gray castle with a tower under an orange roof.
facts.bridge: On the right is a bridge over a moat.
facts.small-crowd: A few people have gathered at the back left.
facts.yellow-sky: The sky is a bright yellow.

glosses.four-wands-garland: A celebration hung on a base that has been set up.
glosses.two-women: A mood of rejoicing and welcome together.

reversedGloss.waning: The air of celebration is there, but it comes small and modest.
reversedGloss.blocked: Schedules or circumstances put off the celebration and the rest.
